decks.notes: This Jund Aggro deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value, utilizing cards like Cauldron Familiar and Mayhem Devil to deal damage to the opponent. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push while generating incremental advantage with Witch's Oven and Claim the Firstborn. The inclusion of cards like Scavenger's Talent and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional utility and card advantage. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and aggressive, constantly pressuring the opponent while disrupting their game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through countering spells, removing opponent's threats, and generating card advantage. Cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils help with card advantage and control, while cards like Supreme Verdict and Settle the Wreckage deal with threats on the board. Memory Deluge and March of Otherworldly Light provide card selection and card advantage. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent while disrupting their game plan, eventually winning through incremental advantage or a big finisher like Castle Ardenvale.

The deck focuses on aggressive play with a combination of creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Monastery Swiftspear, supported by powerful instant spells like Titan's Strength and Fatal Push. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional versatility and mana fixing. The goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and burn spells, maintaining constant pressure and finishing off the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing for explosive starts and relentless aggression.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the board through removal spells and counterspells, while also utilizing card draw and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion allows for additional synergy and versatility in creature matchups. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, stall the game with board wipes like Supreme Verdict, and ultimately win through incremental advantage and out-valuing the opponent with powerful late-game cards like Memory Deluge and Narset, Parter of Veils.

The primary focus of this Arclight Phoenix aggro deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with spells to enable the reanimation of Arclight Phoenix and generate card advantage with Treasure Cruise. With a combination of low-cost spells and card draw, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient threats while disrupting their game plan with counter magic and removal. The inclusion of cards like Hall of Storm Giants and Profit's Eidetic Memory provide additional value and power to the deck's strategy, creating a versatile and aggressive game plan that can quickly close out games.

This deck aims to assemble the Lotus Field combo quickly using cards like Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Sylvan Scrying. Once Lotus Field is in play, the deck can generate a large amount of mana, enabling powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience to be cast. The inclusion of Nine Lives and Strict Proctor helps protect against opposing disruption, while Bala Ged Recovery and Dark Petition provide additional flexibility and recursion. The deck also features lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Otawara, Soaring City to ensure important spells resolve uncontested.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Callous Sell-Sword, Monastery Swiftspear, and Emberheart Challenger, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Monstrous Rage, Titan's Strength, and Reckless Rage provide extra damage and removal options. The deck also benefits from the consistency brought by the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a strong board presence to finish off the opponent swiftly.

The key strategy of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly build a board presence with low-cost creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, and then use cards like Collected Company to bring out powerful creatures like Bishop of Wings, Righteous Valkyrie, and Resplendent Angel. The deck also utilizes cards like Giada, Font of Hope and Inspiring Overseer to buff up the team and gain advantage over the opponent. With a mix of aggressive creatures and support cards, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful offense.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly applying pressure to the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells. With early game disruption like Thoughtseize and Duress, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Archfiend of the Dross to close out the game quickly. The deck also utilizes lands like Castle Locthwain and Den of the Bugbear for additional value and damage potential.

The main concept of this Boros Control deck is to use removal spells and board wipes to control the game, while also utilizing efficient card draw and token generation to maintain card advantage and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion provides additional value and a potential aggressive threat. The deck aims to establish board control and slowly grind out the opponent, using the combination of removal, card advantage, and efficient threats to secure victory in a longer game.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells and removal to dictate the pace of the match. It utilizes card advantage through draw spells like Omen of the Sea and Memory Deluge, along with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, to outvalue opponents. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for extra card advantage by flickering permanents. The deck aims to stall the game with board wipes like Supreme Verdict and Settle the Wreckage before closing it out with powerful finishers like The Wandering Emperor.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce their life total to zero. The deck focuses on efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, as well as powerful burn spells like Titan's Strength and Monstrous Rage. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility to the deck, allowing for additional mana ramp or a powerful late-game threat. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, aggressive, and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful creatures and disrupt the opponent's resources. It combines control elements like Chained to the Rocks and Portable Hole with strong creatures like Elesh Norn and Atraxa to control the board and create a threatening board presence. Fires of Invention allows for explosive plays, while Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional disruption. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for extra value from blinking creatures and permanents. Overall, the deck seeks to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with a variety of threats.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and disruptive spells to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. By playing powerful cards like Elite Spellbinder and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while deploying threats of its own. Collected Company allows for explosive turns by putting multiple creatures on the battlefield at instant speed. With a mix of creatures and disruption, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive strategy centered around the Selesnya color combination.

The deck focuses on putting pressure on opponents with aggressive creatures like Emberheart Challenger, Monastery Swiftspear, and Slickshot Show-Off. It utilizes burn spells like Monstrous Rage, Heartfire Hero, and Ancestral Anger to deal direct damage to the opponent or take out blockers. The inclusion of cards like Jegantha, the Wellspring and Kumano Faces Kakkazan provide additional value and options for the player. The deck aims to close out games quickly by overwhelming the opponent with a mix of creatures and burn spells in a Rakdos colored aggro strategy.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quick, aggressive plays to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing small, efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, along with direct damage spells like Play with Fire and Kumano Faces Kakkazan, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck, allowing for powerful plays even in the late game. The mana base is built to support the aggressive nature of the deck, ensuring fast and consistent land drops.
